facade.notes: the standard freestanding small-format box (about 9,000 sq ft): a pre-engineered metal building with a dark parapet front, brick-faced sides, a lit sign board, a glass entry at one corner; a parking field to the road; woods behind; photographed outside the region; a national type built identically in the Great Lakes towns

why.note: the cheapest possible box with a sign: dollar chains open in towns too small for a supermarket (central place threshold)
a pre-engineered steel building (Type IIB/VB, one storey, under 9-12k sq ft): fast, cheap, code-simple
